Overview Pinned

Based on SonarQube Server 2026.5 LTA. Developer Edition includes the core analysis ring and AI Code Assurance. Data Center Edition includes everything in Enterprise Edition plus high availability and horizontal scaling. Advanced Security, Sonar Vortex, the Remediation Agent and the Hunter Agent are separate subscriptions for Enterprise and Data Center Edition. On SonarQube Server the agentic products run as containers in your infrastructure and send code only to the LLM endpoint you configure. Gitar is a separate Sonar product, hosted by Sonar as SaaS, that works alongside SonarQube Server.
